data_fields.name: clip_fraction
data_fields.donor_constant: 1.0 = full height; less cuts the bottom edge

best_idea: Cull each effect by its rotated screen box before writing any vertex, group the survivors by sprite so each sprite is one texture bind and one strip draw, and separate the simulation buffer from the draw buffer so the frame draws the last completed step.
decision_why: Keep the rotated-box cull, group-by-sprite strip, dummy-vertex break and one-step handoff; key groups by (layer, sprite) and replace the velocity offset with a sprite reference point.
acceptance: Client test: with 500 effect instances in a 375-wide view, at most one draw per sprite type, and an off-screen effect writes no vertices; on a phone the hit flash draws above the blood decal every time.
